title: An honest unknown terminates the explored branch

persona.name: Nadia
persona.brief: Say plainly when you do not know rather than guessing.

mission.objective: Identify who can override a blocked dispatch.
mission.desired_outcome: Name the override decision owner or preserve the gap honestly.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the answer for workflow design.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: Who can override a blocked dispatch?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: Blocked orders need a safe escalation path.
investigation_results.relevant_context: The warehouse coordinator sees dispatch blocks.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The owner is identified, or the interviewee's inability to identify one is recorded.

turns.sourceQuestion: Who can decide that a blocked dispatch should still leave the warehouse?

answer.text: I don't know. I've never seen one overridden, and I don't know who would own that decision.
